title: Metasploit Wrap Up: Belgian Waffles, Chocolates, and…Modules-Frites?
body_markdown:
This wrap-up comes from the beautiful country of Belgium, where the Metasploit team is team-building and team-eating while we cheer on our very own teammates giving talks - shout-out to @jburgess-r7 who gave a wonderful talk about some of his 0day research.


Team building is a wonderful corporate ritual in which security researchers — people whose job is to break stuff and find ways into places they shouldn't be — are released into hotels full of questionable tech, and then everyone acts surprised by what happens next. So far, the only leak has been the Manneken Pis.


Anyway, while we were busy learning that a country with three official languages still has zero words for "one waffle is enough," the internet continued to be on fire.


We’re gonna jump right into the deep end. GitLab. Unauthenticated. Arbitrary file read. Exploited in the wild. That’s it. If you're reading this and your self-hosted GitLab is running anything from 18.7 up to the fixed versions, please stop reading and go patch.


Next, for anyone who has ever wanted to become the DNS server for an entire Windows network without the hassle of asking permission, we now have native mitm6-style DHCPv6 and IPv6 RA DNS takeover modules. Remember that IPv6 stack you never configured, never use, and definitely never disabled? Windows remembers. Windows is very happy to accept a new DNS server from a stranger who asks nicely.


And finally, Langflow brings us authenticated RCE via custom components, continuing the proud AI-industry tradition of building a feature that lets users run arbitrary Python and then being shocked when users run arbitrary Python.


## New module content (5)


### GitLab Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Read


Authors: guneykabel, jheysel-r7, and s3ntago


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21910](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21910) contributed by[jheysel-r7](https://github.com/jheysel-r7)


Path:` gather/gitlab_file_read_cve_2026_85706`


CVE reference:[CVE-2026-85706](https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/etr-cve-2026-85706-critical-gitlab-path-traversal-exploited-in-the-wild/)


Description: Adds a module that exploits CVE-2026-85706, an unauthenticated local file read in the GitLab repository commits and files APIs. The issue affects GitLab CE and EE versions from` 18.7` before` 19.1.8` ,` 19.2` before` 19.2.6` , and` 19.3` before` 19.3.2` .


### DHCPv6 DNS Takeover (mitm6-style IPv6 DNS coercion)


Author: Pushpender Rathore


Type: Auxiliary


Pull request:[#21725](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21725) contributed by[Pushpenderrathore](https://github.com/Pushpenderrathore)


CVE reference:[CVE-2026-20929](https://www.rapid7.com/db/vulnerabilities/cve-2026-20929/)


Description: This adds the auxiliary/spoof/ipv6/ipv6_ra_dns_takeover and auxiliary/spoof/dhcp/dhcpv6_dns_takeover modules to enable native IPv6 DNS-takeover coercion as part of a Kerberos authentication relay attack chain. Operating as a rogue IPv6 router and a rogue DHCPv6 server respectively, these modules trick modern Windows and RFC 8106 clients into adopting the attacker as their recursive DNS server.


This PR adds the following modules:


- ` spoof/dhcp/dhcpv6_dns_takeover`
- ` spoof/ipv6/ipv6_ra_dns_takeover`


### Langflow AI Custom Component Authenticated RCE


Author: Richard Howe <rhowe425>


Type: Exploit


Pull request:[#21848](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21848) contributed by[rmhowe425](https://github.com/rmhowe425)


Path:` multi/http/langflow_auth_rce_cve_2026_18729`


CVE reference:[CVE-2026-18729](https://www.rapid7.com/db/vulnerabilities/cve-2026-18729/)


Description: This adds a new exploit module that detects and exploits an authenticated remote code execution vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-18729 impacting Langflow versions 1.11.1 and below.


### Kate Plugin Persistence


Author: h00die


Type: Exploit


Pull request:[#21461](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21461) contributed by[h00die](https://github.com/h00die)


Path:` multi/persistence/kate_plugin`


Description: This adds a multi platform persistence module for Kate.


## Enhanced Modules (1)


Modules which have either been enhanced, or renamed:


- [#21770](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21770) from[e2002e](https://github.com/e2002e) - This updates the ZoomEye search module to prevent infinite loops and list truncation when encountering empty result pages. It introduces a three-attempt retry limit that skips to the next page if exceeded, caps results per page at 10 to minimize data loss, and refactors the module to support the ZoomEye v2 API.


## Enhancements and features (1)


- [#21892](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21892) from[cdelafuente-r7](https://github.com/cdelafuente-r7) - This updates the AGENTS.md file with more granular rules outlining to how to write modules and their corresponding documentation files.


## Bugs fixed (9)


- [#21823](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21823) from[DanielSwift1992](https://github.com/DanielSwift1992) - Fixes typos in several GitHub workflows.
- [#21880](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21880) from[adfoster-r7](https://github.com/adfoster-r7) - Update the iOS image gather module to use` store_loot` for consistency with other modules.
- [#21881](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21881) from[adfoster-r7](https://github.com/adfoster-r7) - Ensure auth is available on the credentials endpoints.
- [#21885](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21885) from[adfoster-r7](https://github.com/adfoster-r7) - Adds additional validation to the marshal validator.
- [#21905](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21905) from[sjanusz-r7](https://github.com/sjanusz-r7) - Fixes broken encoders, previously both` x86/xor_poly` and` x86/avoid_underscore_tolower` were returning errors when attempting encoding.
- [#21916](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21916) from[adfoster-r7](https://github.com/adfoster-r7) - Updates the` db_import` validation logic to be consistent across the different import data types.
- [#21917](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21917) from[sjanusz-r7](https://github.com/sjanusz-r7) - Adds additional validation to the credential model updates.
- [#21918](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21918) from[adfoster-r7](https://github.com/adfoster-r7) - Adds additional validation to the RDP protocol support to handle unexpected sizes packets and responses.
- [#21930](https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/21930) from[adfoster-r7](https://github.com/adfoster-r7) - Replace recursive call to dn expand.
